deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O7a Invitation' and 'O7b Accepted, awaiting verification': no app bar; the app draws an app bar titled 'Your invitation' on the raised surface with a divider
deviations.reason: [shared] app bar: the app wraps S0.9 in a titled AppBar; these frames have none

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O7a Invitation: the inviter is named before accepting — an 'AK' initials avatar, 'Amrit Kaur', 'Admin · Sharma Family', then the heading 'has invited you to Sharma Family'; the app shows 'You have been invited' and a card '3 shared books — The names come after you accept. A phone that has not joined is shown nothing about a family or a business — not even who asked.'
deviations.reason: [screen] the frame is right: DESIGN-PACK §O7 specifies this header — 'a screen reading "Amrit Kaur has invited you to Sharma Family" with the roles being granted listed as chips' — and DESIGN-PACK ranks with the numbered specs on visual and interaction matters (CLAUDE.md § Precedence item 2). The app cannot draw it from what it receives: the offer (members_api.dart InviteOffer: invite id, tenant id, per-book role ids, expiry, creator id) carries no inviter, tenant or book names, so it is a data gap, not a skin difference. The app's copy 'A phone that has not joined is shown nothing … not even who asked' (onboarding.invite.offer.hidden) over-states ADR 2026-09-05d §2 🔒, which rules only for devices without a server-verified certificate; how the names reach the joiner (and the copy) is reported in open
deviations.authority: design/DESIGN-PACK.md §O7; CLAUDE.md § Precedence item 2; app/lib/features/members/members_api.dart InviteOffer; ADR 2026-09-05d §2 🔒 (scope: uncertified devices)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O7a Invitation: an overline 'YOU WOULD BE GIVEN' over role chips ('Member · Joint fund', 'Head · Ramesh household', 'Viewer · Kirana Store'); the app has no role chips — only a count, and the link's expiry ('This link stops working on …') with a clock, which the frame does not draw
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK §O7 asks for 'the roles being granted listed as chips'; the roles are on the wire and could be drawn, the book names are not (same data gap as above). Chips are a [shared] component gap (chip)

deviations.reason: [shared] tertiary text button colour (muted on canvas, primary in the app) + [screen] placement and label
